messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — anomaly detected in hosted spend for several accounts during last 24h. automated flag bumped 3 customers into high-variance. seeing a ~3x short spike vs commit baseline around 09:12 UTC yesterday. @jules_fin can you check billing exposure? :eyes:

alex_re: Thanks Maria. Any list of customer IDs or example orgs? can we get top 10 by spike size?

maria_cs: Yep attaching quick query I ran, results below. basically customer_a, customer_b, and neon-ops had the biggest jumps.

maria_cs: ```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(billed_tokens) AS tokens, avg(tokens_per_min) AS avg_tpm
FROM billing_usage
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

jules_fin: I pulled ledger. provisional exposure if they keep current pace = $18k this month vs commit $6k. flagged for CSM outreach. who owns customer_b?

sam_support: I can take parallel check on whether errors or latency correlated. quick look at traces shows short burst of 429s on the hosted API gateway around 09:10-09:16 UTC. logs: "rate_limit_exceeded: true" for many requests.

ops_bot: deploy-bot posted: new routing policy rollout to us-west-2 completed at 2026-03-18T09:05:22Z.

alex_re: good catch. could be rollout + a bursty client pattern. sam, can you confirm if those 429s map to the same customer_ids?

sam_support: yes — matching trace IDs point to customer_a and neon-ops. looks like many small streaming sessions opened concurrently. error rate peaked at 6% for that window, baseline ~0.2%

maria_cs: not seeing embeddings-only usage — it's primarily chat/completions. Model pinned to rwd-3b. any known model fallback or autoscaling hiccups?

alex_re: autoscaler metrics look OK, but we did have a short cache-warm miss after the us-west rollout which temporarily raised per-token compute. combined with client retry loops it could create a spiral.

jules_fin: from finance: I'll temporarily reclassify the spike as "post-deploy transient" for the monthly reconciliation but will leave the customer-facing billing as-is until CSMs confirm no contract violation.

maria_cs: action items: 1) sam to export list of affected request_ids + org_ids and confirm retried vs unique calls (ETA 2h). 2) alex to add a rollback-safe routing tweak to reduce new-session routing to canary pool (ETA 1h). 3) jules to draft CSM note outlining transient root cause + offer credits if churn risk (ETA EOD). 4) finance to hold charge classification pending CSM feedback.

sam_support: got it — exporting now, will DM the list. :white_check_mark:

alex_re: I'll add a temporary rate-smoothing override for us-west canary routes, monitoring for 30m. ping when it's live. :gear:

jules_fin: drafting note and share in this thread before sending. keeping it transparent but not alarmist.

maria_cs: thanks team. please drop any follow-ups here. i'm also adding a quick query to our weekly health pack to surface short-duration spikes (3-15 min) vs commit baseline so we don't miss these transient events. :pray:
